dogecoin.text: Bitcoin and Ethereum aren't the only digital currencies that are hitting record highs this week. Dogecoin, the crypocurrency that features the face of a Shiba Inu dog as its logo, has surpassed 10 cents for the first time. https://t.co/SbZmBv8Uh5
Late Thursday, as Dogecoin rallied past 25 cents for the first time, high demand put "extreme pressure" on Robinhood's crypto trading systems, the company said in a blog post https://t.co/DiBFUm1fEC
The price of a single dogecoin jumped as much as 20% on Tuesday to 42 cents, nearing Friday's all-time high of 45 cents, according to CoinDesk data. https://t.co/AkxQuAm48k
